# epsilon-maven-plugin

> A Maven plugin that integrates Eclipse Epsilon model transformation scripts (EOL, ETL, EML, ECL, EVL, EGL, EGX) into Maven builds, with support for EMF, XML, and Excel models.

Key facts:
- Java 11, single-module Maven plugin (`maven-plugin` packaging)
- Built with Maven 3.8.x via Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`)
- Eclipse Epsilon 1.5.1 runtime with BlackBelt's epsilon-runtime-execution abstraction
- Provides three goals: `execute`, `executeConfiguration`, and `parseHutn`
- Resolves Maven artifacts as model resources via a custom `mvn:` URI scheme handler
- Part of the BlackBelt/JUDO ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, architecture overview, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines
- [RELEASE-NOTES.md](RELEASE-NOTES.md): Version changelog

## Source — Maven Goals

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/ExecuteEpsilonMojo.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/ExecuteEpsilonMojo.java): `epsilon:execute` goal — runs Epsilon programs configured directly in the POM
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/executeConfiguration/ExecuteEpsilonXmlConfigurationMojo.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/executeConfiguration/ExecuteEpsilonXmlConfigurationMojo.java): `epsilon:executeConfiguration` goal — runs Epsilon programs from external XML config files
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/parsehutn/ParseHutnMojo.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/parsehutn/ParseHutnMojo.java): `epsilon:parseHutn` goal — parses HUTN files into EMF models

## Source — Shared Infrastructure

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/AbstractEpsilonMojo.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/AbstractEpsilonMojo.java): Base Mojo with shared parameters for model lists, metamodels, and Maven repository system
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/MavenURIHandler.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/MavenURIHandler.java): Resolves `mvn:groupId:artifactId:version` URIs via Maven Aether
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/MavenLog.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/MavenLog.java): Bridges Maven logging to SLF4J for the Epsilon runtime

## Source — Model Types

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/EmfModel.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/EmfModel.java): EMF model configuration with validation, caching, and URI mapping
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/XmlModel.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/XmlModel.java): XML model with XSD schema support
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/PlainXmlModel.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/PlainXmlModel.java): Plain XML model without schema
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/ExcelModel.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/epsilon/maven/plugin/execute/ExcelModel.java): Excel spreadsheet model

## Configuration

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Single-module Maven POM with `${revision}` CI-friendly versioning
- [src/main/resources/epsilon_plugin_v1.xsd](src/main/resources/epsilon_plugin_v1.xsd): XML Schema for `executeConfiguration` goal config files

## Depends on

- [epsilon-runtime](../epsilon-runtime): Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi environments
